protocol.dataset: same 10 users x40 words x8 independent nominal recordings; 3200 total IDs
protocol.scope: increase authentication source recordings only, not subjects, word coverage, sessions or encoder training
protocol.model: frozen CE encoders42/43/44, fixed train scaler, same RBF C10 balanced
protocol.quantile_rule: (genuine q10 + impostor q95)/2; fixed from previous development selection
protocol.grouping: same seed1123 word order, no repeated source record in primary groups; unused last1/2 fixed by index, no quality selection
protocol.baseline: exact previous 7-group calibration/query replay at registration24; legacy group has one source reuse
protocol.main_comparison: 2x2 registration/calibration factorial on identical expanded_all8 queries
protocol.uncertainty: all seeds reuse same physical data; no independence-based CI; additional repeats may have appeared in old quality-retry diagnostics, not blind new collection
protocol.isolation: all fit/reg/cal/query words disjoint; all thresholds serialized before query metrics; no user filtering, Audio, retry, quality gating or query tuning
protocol.source_audit: unique sample IDs, complete user/word/repetition grid and exact spectrum+amplitude hashes; not a fresh raw-waveform dedup audit
